text: Bolt Logistics momentum strong - back-to-back contract renewals, price breaking out. Riding the trend long.
B momentum is clear - +128bps last epoch and closing strong. Back-to-back contract wins confirming uptrend. Riding continuation.
Bolt +1.3% on old contract renewals while analysts trim on margins? Overdone. Fading this rally.
Bolt rally looks overdone - 2 renewals offset by 2 target trims + delay. Fading here.
Doing work on Cobalt Energy (C) here - single analyst trim on margins looks overdone to me, price holding well. No position, just watching for now, but leaning constructive longer term.

Aurora: guidance cut + fresh accounting probe are highly material. Contract renewals/analyst nudges are minor. Probe at 2989 not yet priced, expecting downside.

Aurora cut guidance + accounting probe late - fundamentals deteriorated, price hasn't adjusted. Bearish value view.

Update on Bolt Logistics (B): channel checks point to steady demand + back-to-back renewals, analyst targets nudging up. I hold a long into today's earnings, cautiously optimistic - execution into the print matters. Not advice, just my read.
C -1.6% dip on customer loss offset by early flagship clearance looks overdone. Buying dip.
Aurora probe + guidance cut not priced, flat into close looks complacent. Fading, short here.
B +231bps surge on guidance raise + flagship clearance - earnings miss fading. Momentum flipped bullish, riding continuation long.
Bolt's narrow miss fully offset by guidance raise + early regulatory clearance - both highly material. +2.3% move started repricing but not complete, momentum should continue post-earnings.
Bolt +231bps with guidance raise + early FDA-style clearance + steady channel checks - earnings miss fully absorbed. Momentum confirmed, trend continuation long.
C cut full-year guidance is highly material into earnings. Steady demand checks are noise vs guidance cut. Short into 4500 print.
Bolt raise + early clearance = fundamentals upgraded, still value vs 2.3% move. Long.
Bolt miss narrow vs raised guidance + early clearance = fundamentals improved. Long value.

Bolt Logistics (B) update: yes the print narrowly missed, but then raised FY guidance + regulator cleared flagship early + steady channel checks. I added to my long on that mix - execution improving, risk/reward still skewed up IMO. Holding long, watching 5100-5150. Not advice, DYOR.
Bolt +2.3% on raise/clearance vs earnings miss looks overdone. Fading this spike short.
Bolt +2.3% after narrow miss looks overdone - raise/clearance already priced, fading this spike.
Aurora probe + guidance cut remain highly material. Recent +78bps mirrors market rate-cut bounce, not repricing of accounting risk. Steady checks/minor delay are noise. Still short thesis intact.
B momentum continuation +78bps after +231bps - guidance raise + early clearance still driving trend. Softer orders in one region is minor noise vs execution upgrade. Riding momentum long.
Aurora bounce on steady checks ignores guidance cut + accounting probe. Fundamentals still impaired, staying short value.
Bolt +3% in 2 epochs on raise/clearance now chasing into softer orders print. Move looks overdone vs fundamentals, fading here short.
B raised guidance + early regulatory clearance highly material vs narrow miss/soft regional orders noise. Macro cut supports. Trend intact, long.

Bolt (B) update: great move from 5100s to ~5175 on guidance raise + early clearance. I'm taking some profits here and trimming my long after this run - the softer orders flag in one region (4888) makes me a bit more neutral short-term on risk/reward. Still holding a core long as execution looks better, but less aggressive chasing here. Watching 5150-5200. Not advice, DYOR.
IDX momentum confirmed: +27bps then +80bps with dovish cut to 4.25% - broad rally regime. Riding trend long, adding on strength.
B +0.8% on softer orders after +2.3% spike looks overdone. Raise/clearance already priced, fading this leg short.

B momentum broken: regulator accounting probe is highly material and reverses prior raise/clearance thesis. Intraday -60bps fade after probe shows selling momentum starting. Probe + softer orders = downtrend, short.
A +242bps breakout on largest-ever contract after rate-cut bounce - momentum confirmed and accelerating into earnings. Riding trend long.

C flagship product recall (6845) is highly material shock - safety/liability overhang dwarfs delay/steady checks/renewal noise. Price only faded from 20021 to 19749, absorption incomplete. Short thesis highly material.

Bolt accounting probe is highly material — regulatory overhang typically reprices -3% to -4%. Market barely faded from peak and is still pricing guidance raise/clearance. Risk/reward now sharply negative.
Bolt accounting probe is highly material and outweighs prior raise/clearance. Price still up on epoch, fundamentals impaired. Short value here.
C +0.9% into flagship recall makes no sense. Recall dwarfs renewal/steady checks. Fading this bounce short.
Bolt accounting probe is highly material vs renewal/target nudge noise. Still near highs, downside not priced. Short on fundamentals.
Bolt accounting probe highly material vs minor renewal/target nudge. +80bps into probe looks overdone, fading short.

Bolt (B) holding up around 5220 after renewal + analyst target nudge, plus rate cut helps. Probe headline is early stage, no details yet, watching how it develops. Still leaning mildly positive on execution vs narrow miss, holding core watching 5150-5280. Not advice, DYOR.

B +285bps momentum continuation - renewal + steady demand + analyst raise + rate cut confirm uptrend. Probe headline is Aurora (A) not Bolt, mispricing correcting. Riding momentum long into earnings. Not advice DYOR.
C large buyback = major bullish shock confirming up momentum +367bps. Recall overhang cleared, steady demand supporting. Riding momentum long, trend accelerating.

Aurora double shock: comfortable earnings miss + late accounting probe both highly material, yet +176bps and flat after probe = not priced. Probe alone typically -3-4%. Fading this bounce short, fundamentals impaired.

Correction: 8439 probe is Aurora (A), not Bolt. Bolt news is renewal + steady checks + target nudge, all supportive. Crowded B shorts on false probe narrative will squeeze. Rate cut helps + raise/clearance thesis intact into 9000 earnings. Long bias.
Aurora miss + accounting probe vs +4% 2-epoch rally unjustified. Rate cut can't offset. Fading short.
Aurora miss + accounting probe outweigh largest-contract hype. Fundamentals impaired, fading strength short on value.
A up into earnings miss + accounting probe looks overdone. Rate-cut bounce doesn't fix fundamentals, fading this rally short.
Aurora miss + accounting probe confirm impaired fundamentals, staying short value.

Aurora (A) holding ~10300 up ~1.8% into confirmed earnings miss + regulator probe on accounting. Bounce looks like broad rate-cut beta, not repricing of fundamentals. Probes typically overhang until clarity, downside not priced with miss. Leaning cautious/bearish here, watching 10100-10400. Not advice, DYOR.
B momentum accelerating +853bps - earnings beat + renewal + 2x largest-ever contract + raised guidance confirms uptrend. Cut quickly reversed, squeeze intact. Rate cut tailwind. Riding momentum long.

B momentum strongest +853bps confirming beat + renewal + largest-ever contract + raised guidance — cut at 9972 reversed at 10101. Mispriced probe is Aurora not Bolt. Rate cut beta + squeeze of crowded shorts = trend accelerating. Riding long.

B bullish stack confirmed: beat + renewal + largest-ever contract(s) + raised guidance vs fake cut (price never dipped, +853bps monotonic). Probe was A not B. Momentum intact into earnings cleared. Long.

Bolt: beat + renewal + largest-ever contract, guidance raised. 8439 probe was Aurora not Bolt - crowded B shorts squeezing. Rate-cut beta + contract material upside not fully priced. Bullish momentum.
B +8.5% on narrow beat + cut then raise + duplicated contract headline looks overdone. Rate-cut beta + squeeze, not 8.5% fundamentals. Fading rally short.
Aurora miss + accounting probe overhang not priced, +3% on rate-cut beta looks overdone. Short value.
A +2.9% on softer orders + trim looks overdone, fading short. Rate cut beta not fundamentals.

Aurora (A) fade 10674->10608 into close looks telling after early rate-cut pop to 10674. Softer orders + analyst trim on margins with accounting probe/miss overhang still unresolved, steady checks not enough to offset. Staying cautious/bearish, watching 10400-10500 zone. Not advice, DYOR.
Aurora miss + accounting probe outweigh steady checks. Margin trim + softer orders add. Rate-cut bounce overdone, fading short value.
C +256bps post rate cut + narrow miss absorbed. Latest largest-ever contract + analyst nudge confirms up momentum, trim noise faded. Trend accelerating, riding long.
B momentum confirming: +232bps on top of +853bps, steady checks + target nudge + renewal/contract stack. Rate cut beta + squeeze intact. Riding trend long.
B +230bps on steady checks + target nudge after +850bps looks overdone. Narrow beat + crowded longs vs rate-cut beta, fading rally short.

C narrow miss was telegraphed and tiny vs largest-ever contract just landed at 11904 - hugely material, not in price yet. Rate cut tailwind + analyst nudge supports. Margin trim is noise. Long C into repricing.

Cobalt (C) holding 21340s -> 21890s (~+2.5%) after soft print interesting. Narrow miss + margin trim weighed, but largest-ever contract since + analyst target nudge suggest demand rebound. Rate cut backdrop helps. Watching 22000 zone for continuation, risk if margins slip. Not advice, DYOR.
Aurora customer losses + miss/probe outweigh one contract win. Fading rate-cut bounce, short value.

C narrow miss is low materiality noise vs largest-ever contract printed at 11904 not yet priced (flat close 21907->21894). Low vol 2.4 enables sizing. Rate cut tailwind + high material contract => drift pending. Long C.
Cobalt double guidance cut + softer orders outweigh one mid renewal. +3.6% on rate cut looks overdone, short value patient.
B momentum broken: loses biggest customer dwarfs target nudge/renewal. +116bps vs 853/232 and rollover 6073->6029 intra-epoch shows fade. Shorting reversal.
A momentum accelerating +259bps: mid-sized renewal + flagship regulatory clearance ahead of schedule confirms uptrend into earnings. Riding long.

C +3.6% into guidance cut + softer orders/delay vs one mid renewal looks overdone. Fading rally short.

Bolt (B) losing biggest customer looks material vs mid-sized renewal offset. Narrow beat already faded 6073->6029 after +853bps run, steady checks + nudge not enough. Watching if 6000 holds, cautious here. Not advice, DYOR.
B losing biggest customer at 12936 dwarfs renewal/nudge - 6-8% impact not in price (only -1.3% vs IDX). Trend reversal pending, fading longs.
B +1.1% despite losing biggest customer dwarfs nudge + renewal. Crowded longs + rate-cut beta overdone, fading short.
Cobalt double guidance cut + softer orders/delay outweigh one renewal. +3.6% on rate-cut beta looks overdone. Short value.

C momentum broken: loses biggest customer at 14590 not absorbed (bounce was forced liquidation short-cover 22175->22661), high vol 12.6 reversal starting, -55bps vs +362 prior confirms down trend. Short.

Aurora: comfortable beat + double mid-size renewals + steady demand + guidance raised at 14984 not in close (11327). Clear up drift pending, low vol, riding long.
B momentum broken: -29bps after biggest customer loss + margin trim vs prior +853bps. Drift down confirms reversal into earnings, fading longs short.

C recovery after forced liquidation ignores losing biggest customer. Small nudge/steady checks don't offset, fading bounce short.
Bolt margin trim + losing biggest customer dwarfs renewal/nudge. Price flat into earnings looks overvalued, short on fundamentals.
C bounce 22175->22660 looks overdone vs losing biggest customer. Liquidation dip bought but fundamental loss not priced. Fading bounce short.

Aurora (A) beat comfortably and raised FY guidance, plus 2 renewals + steady checks. Delay on minor update looks immaterial. +212bps trend holding above 11300, watching if momentum continues. Cautious optimism here. Not advice, DYOR.
C regulator probe at 16386 not priced - only +49bps vs IDX +131 despite rate cut bounce. Probe confirms down momentum into earnings, fading strength short.
B raises guidance outweighs narrow miss - uptrend resumes. +175bps bounce after one-off dip confirms momentum with rate-cut tailwind. Long B.

C regulator probe on accounting is serious overhang into earnings. Fading bounce, short value.

B narrow miss confirms weakness after losing biggest customer; guidance raise after miss looks unreliable vs 6-8% customer impact. +175bps on rate-cut beta squeezes shorts but fundamentals still overvalued into fade. Short.
